usageNotes: Use this to inspect the output of a specific replication job run on a given node — useful for diagnosing sync failures, verifying successful snapshot transfer, or auditing replication history. The caller must have VM.Audit on the replicated VM's /vms/<vmid> or Sys.Audit on /nodes/<node>. Paginate large logs with 'start' and 'limit'; each item returns line number ('n') and text ('t').

examples.summary: Fetch the first 50 lines of the replication log for job 101-0 on node pve1

tips: The job ID format is '<VMID>-<JOBNUM>' (e.g. '101-0'). VMID must be 3–9 digits starting with 1-9; JOBNUM is 1–9 digits.
If the log is empty, the job may not have run yet or the node may not be the replication source for that job.
Omit 'limit' to retrieve all available log lines in a single response; use pagination for very verbose jobs.
Replication logs are ephemeral per-run; only the most recent job execution log is available via this endpoint.
